highlights: Founder Teejay Asciak was a Sous Chef on Jamie Oliver's team
Drop-off buffets from £16.95 per person, delivered by their own drivers
Private chef menus from Best of British to Go Greek
Dishes labelled with allergen information; full buffet allergen list published
Food hygiene rating of 5 at the Hoddesdon kitchen
Christmas Dinner Cook at Home boxes for 4 or 6

howItWorks.title: Send an enquiry
howItWorks.text: Use the enquiry form on their website to describe the occasion, date, location and any preferences or requirements, and choose the service you want, such as a drop-off buffet, serviced buffet, afternoon tea or private dining. Enquiries, quotations and provisional dates are not confirmed bookings.

howItWorks.title: Secure the date
howItWorks.text: A 35% deposit secures a standard booking, or you can pay in full; a 50% deposit may be required for peak periods, including Christmas. A booking is confirmed only once the company has accepted it and the Terms and Conditions have been accepted.

howItWorks.title: Finalise menus and numbers
howItWorks.text: Menu selections should be finalised as early as possible and normally no later than 14 days before the event, and any increase in guest numbers should normally be requested at least 14 days ahead. The final balance is normally due 14 days before the event.

howItWorks.title: On the day
howItWorks.text: For serviced buffets the team generally arrives 1 hour 30 minutes to 2 hours before serving time, serves for up to 2 hours and needs up to 1 hour to clear down; a private chef team arrives 1–2 hours before dinner. Any leftover food is boxed up for you to keep.

goodToKnow.text: Buffet packages have a minimum of 30 people for 5 options and 25 people for 7, 9 or 11 options, with the 11-option buffet published at 'from £22.95 per person'.

BBQ packages run from '3 mains & 3 sides from £38 per person (minimum of 25 people)' to '7 mains & 7 sides from £68 per person (minimum of 15 people)', and 'All bookings will require to pay a £30 gas charge.' The BBQ needs power (around three 13-amp supplies), water and washing-up facilities.

The Roast Dinner private chef menu is 'priced from £80 per person with a minimum of 10 people'; 'Additional staff charges starting from £150 will apply', optional sides are '£2.50pp per group' and a Farmhouse Cheese Board add-on is '£6.50pp per group'.
'A 35% deposit is required for standard bookings.' 'A 50% deposit may be required for peak periods, including Christmas.' 'The final balance is normally due 14 days before the event.'
'Serviced event fees start from £300, depending on guest numbers, requirements and staffing.' 'Additional time may be charged at £100 per hour per member of staff, or another rate agreed in writing.'

'A fuel and travel charge starting from £15 may apply.' A 12.5% service charge, additional to the standard booking or quoted price, applies to serviced events taking place on any bank holiday, public holiday or recognised observance day.
Where a venue kitchen is unsuitable, an equipment hire charge of at least £150 may apply, and a £50 refundable equipment deposit may be required.

Menu selections should be finalised 'normally no later than 14 days before the event', and increases in guest numbers 'should normally be requested at least 14 days before the event'; once confirmed, guest numbers cannot be reduced. No minimum notice period for making a booking is published.

Serviced buffets need access to a kitchen at the home or venue; if none is available, a space to operate from is needed and a hire fee applies for equipment. Serving tables and tablecloths are not provided as standard, and crockery dinner plates and silver cutlery in place of disposables carry an additional fee.

Published delivery postcodes cover E, N, NW, W and SE London, EN, AL, WD and SG in Enfield and Hertfordshire, IG, RM, CM and SS15 in Essex and CM17–CM23 around Harlow and Bishop's Stortford; other postcodes may be arranged at additional cost.
Buffet dishes carry dietary markers (v, vg, gf, n), and gluten-free alternatives are available on request for an additional fee.
The Food Standards Agency register lists the Hoddesdon unit, under the name 'The Farmhouse Essex', with a food hygiene rating of 5 from an inspection on 10 July 2024.
Christmas Dinner Cook at Home boxes are delivered, or collected from Farmhouse HQ, on 23 December, and the published box price 'includes delivery'.

faqs.a: Any event, they say. Serviced buffets are suggested for birthdays, weddings, communions, christenings, graduations, anniversaries, corporate events and baby showers.

faqs.q: How is a drop-off buffet delivered?
faqs.a: Dishes are prepared by their chefs and delivered cold on disposable platters, ready to serve. If a serving table is ready, staff will set out the platters so guests simply remove the lids. Reheating is not recommended, though it is up to the customer.

faqs.q: What is included in a serviced buffet?
faqs.a: Hot and cold dishes cooked on site by chefs and wait staff, full buffet decor, labelled dishes with allergen information, crockery tableware, chafing dishes, disposable plates and cutlery, up to 2 hours of food service, setup and clear-down. Crockery dinner plates and silver cutlery can be provided for an additional fee.

faqs.q: How long is the team on site for a serviced buffet?
faqs.a: Timings vary, but generally they arrive 1 hour 30 minutes to 2 hours before serving time for setup and preparation. The buffet service lasts up to 2 hours, and they need up to 1 hour to clear down afterwards. If you would like to keep any leftover food, the team will box it up for you.

faqs.q: How does private chef dining work?
faqs.a: Their chefs and wait staff arrive 1–2 hours before dinner with all the cooking equipment, crockery and cutlery, then cook, serve and clear throughout the evening. One starter (excluding sharer boards), one main and one dessert are chosen for the whole party; a second main may be possible if at least 50% of the party orders it. They say they can cater for all dietary requirements and allergies.

faqs.q: What does the BBQ package need from the venue?
faqs.a: Power (around three 13-amp supplies), water and washing-up facilities. The team brings a 3m x 3m gazebo, the BBQ and equipment, serving tables with hessian cloths, crockery serving plates, wooden boards and hot plates with decor, plus disposable plates, cutlery and napkins for guests; crockery and silver cutlery can be hired. Every booking pays a £30 gas charge.

faqs.q: Can canapés be ordered on their own?
faqs.a: No. Handmade cold and hot canapés are available only as an addition to private chef or bowl food menus, served on guests' arrival by a dedicated on-site chef and wait staff. They recommend a minimum of 5 canapés per guest, served for up to an hour.

faqs.q: What is in a Christmas Dinner Cook at Home box?
faqs.a: A fully prepared, vacuum-packed roast for 4 or 6 people: rolled turkey breast with lemon and herb garlic butter, beef sirloin with a mustard and rosemary crust, or a Farmhouse vegan pie, each with rosemary and garlic roast potatoes, honey-glazed carrots and parsnips, seasonal greens, giant Yorkshire puddings and gravy. Boxes arrive insulated and ice-packed with foil oven trays and finishing instructions, and the published prices are 'Turkey Box from £88', 'Beef Sirloin Box from £125' and 'Veg Pie Box from £88'.

serviceDetails.name: Drop-off buffets
serviceDetails.more: Published tiers run '5 options from £16.95 per person (minimum of 30 people)', '7 options from £18.95 per person (minimum of 25 people)', '9 options from £20.95 per person (minimum of 25 people)' and '11 options from £22.95 per person (minimum of 25 people)'. Dishes include arancini, chicken escalope, lemon and garlic chicken kebabs, Farmhouse sausage rolls, Greek keftedes, falafel, finger sandwiches, pizzette and goat's cheese tarts. Sides serving up to 15 people (for example a Farmhouse Cheese Board at £24.00) can be added only with a buffet package, and mini desserts are 'per dessert £3.75pp or a choice of 3 desserts for £9.75pp' with a minimum order of 20 portions per dessert.

serviceDetails.name: Hot serviced buffets
serviceDetails.more: Food is charged at the same per-person rates as the drop-off buffet, from £16.95 to £22.95 per person, plus the serviced fee. Crockery tableware, hot food chafing dishes and disposable plates and cutlery are included as standard, with crockery dinner plates and silver cutlery available for an additional fee. Kitchen access is required, serving tables are not provided as standard, and the team boxes up leftovers for the client.

serviceDetails.name: BBQ catering
serviceDetails.more: Packages are '3 mains & 3 sides from £38 per person (minimum of 25 people)', '5 mains & 5 sides from £53 per person (minimum of 20 people)' and '7 mains & 7 sides from £68 per person (minimum of 15 people)'. Mains span chicken, pork, lamb, beef (including hanger, sirloin, tomahawk and T-bone steaks and Farmhouse burgers), fish and vegetables, with around 25 sides. Supplements of £2pp (baby back ribs) or £2.50pp (lamb dishes, steaks, tuna, tiger prawns) apply to some mains, sauces are '£7 each for up to 15 people' and desserts are 'Choose 3 desserts for £9.75pp | 5 desserts for £14.75pp'.

serviceDetails.name: Private chef dining
serviceDetails.more: Menus are Italian Feast, Best of British, Spanish Fiesta, Go Greek, Roast Dinner, A La Carte, Bowl Food and Canapés, or a bespoke menu on request. Best of British, Spanish Fiesta and Go Greek are 'priced from £75 per person with a minimum of 10 people'; Italian Feast, Roast Dinner and A La Carte are 'priced from £80 per person with a minimum of 10 people'. 'Additional staff charges starting from £150 will apply', optional sides are '£2.50pp per group', Go Greek's Essex Lamb and Mixed Grill carry a 'supplement £5 pp', and the A La Carte Porterhouse and surf 'n' turf are '£tbc at point of booking'. Suggested for intimate gatherings, family celebrations, bridal showers, rehearsal dinners, birthday parties and anniversary celebrations.

serviceDetails.name: Bowl food and canapés
serviceDetails.more: Bowl food covers around 35 savoury bowls across British, Italian, comfort and world dishes plus 13 dessert bowls, served in disposable tableware on serving boards, from '3 options from £23 per person (minimum of 30 people / savoury dishes only)' to '9 options from £59 per person (minimum of 25 people)', with 'additional service charges starting from £300' and kitchen access required. Canapés offer 19 cold and 19 hot options from '3 options from £9 per person' to '9 options from £22 per person', also with service charges starting from £300.

serviceDetails.name: Cook at Home boxes
serviceDetails.more: Year-round boxes for 2, 4 or 6 sold through the online shop include Farmhouse Burgers, pies, curries, BBQ Pulled Pork, Rolled Roast Chicken and Italian Roast Lamb, each with cooking instructions. Christmas Dinner boxes are 'Turkey Box from £88', 'Beef Sirloin Box from £125' and 'Veg Pie Box from £88' for 4 or 6 people, with 'Sides & Desserts from £4' such as Pigs in Blankets (£9.50), Cauliflower Cheese (£9.00) and a Farmhouse Christmas Cheese Board (£30.00). Emailed gift vouchers are 'Available in denominations of £10 and £20' and are valid for 12 months from issue.

Prices are quoted verbatim from the service pages, which were last modified 1 October 2026; the online shop still lists older, lower buffet and serviced prices, so shop figures were not used. The Terms and Conditions page was re-opened on 1 Nov 2026 to confirm the deposit, balance, serviced-fee, overtime, travel, bank-holiday and equipment clauses, and it supplied the 14-day menu-selection and guest-increase deadlines; no page states a minimum notice period for booking, so none is given. Left out: Afternoon Tea (no page or price), the Kids Buffet shop product (shows £0.00), the Algarve sister site's menus (no prices), the Google reviews quoted on the site and their mentions of a front-of-house contact named Charlotte (not verified), and the conflicting start dates (company incorporated January 2021, footer '© 2025', domain captures from 2018).
